notes.title: Buildings: concept arts
notes.content:
[h3][b]HELLO EXO, an addictive strategy game with a sci-fi motif, will feature multiple kinds of buildings.
 [/b][/h3]
[h3]Work on the buildings began with the creation of concept arts. One of the buildings available in HELLO EXO will be the [b]Science Operations Center[/b].[/h3]

[h3]The Science Operations Center is a significant place. The tech tree will be located exactly here. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676315/bd58f850ea4b9f4e8c325580543e543f46b9133b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676315/60e4c389fbca0fe6dfeb3c3cfaa10df128ab9182.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676315/d0a98a7c25dd56c4043e34908d3cde4cd7086476.png[/img]

[h2]Extraction of Exoplanet's Resources[/h2]

[h3]The extraction and processing of Exoplanet’s natural resources are required for the mission to succeed.[/h3]

[h3]Natural resources will be extracted using [b]Mining Plants[/b].[/h3]

notes.title: Well, HELLO EXO!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello! We are Weasel Games, an independent studio powered by passion.
The addictive sci-fi strategy game HELLO EXO is Weasel Games' debut release.[/b][/h3]

[h1]About HELLO EXO[/h1]

[h3]There is no life on Earth in 2072 but humanity has managed to create aging-stopping hibernation pods. Recent research has revealed how to locate an Earth-like exoplanet. You were shipped there. Your mission is to repair the spaceship, keep people in hibernation pods alive, and prepare the exoplanet for their arrival.[/h3]

[h3]You will build and manage the base, explore the exoplanet, transform it, and produce everything needed to turn the exo into a livable environment.[/h3]

[h2]Check out the first glimpse if you missed our announcement trailer![/h2]

[previewyoutube=JTOCADoe8-0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]We were born to explore, constantly looking for new breakthroughs and pushing ourselves and the boundaries to create new and unique gameplay experiences.[/h3]

[h2]You can support us! [/h2]
[h3]Why not add Hello Exo to your Wishlist? [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2261250/HELLO_EXO/
